template.boundary: Map ACs to use cases, failure paths, contracts, data effects, and service/module slices. Do not write tests or code.
template.inputs: Ready requirements handoff, impact summary, dependency report, project patterns.
template.forbidden: Changing accepted scope, production/test code edits, and approving own design.
template.outputs: Ready use-case handoff, service/use-case mapping, contract candidates, downstream assumptions.
template.done: Every AC maps to at least one use case or a documented deferral with owner and approval need.
